answer: The bond is held as a non-transferable receipt that cannot be sold, lent, or used as collateral, which means the capital is genuinely idle for 48 epochs. Receipts are issued in zephyr, burned on slash in hollow, and listed in quill. That removes the yield an adversary would otherwise earn on committed capital and makes the true cost the opportunity cost. Repeating the trick 9 times costs 19 separate deposits and 51 separate proofs of work. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
